wilfred/.agents/skills/api-audit/SKILL.m.name: Server request security check
wilfred/.agents/skills/api-audit/SKILL.m.description: Guides an AI assistant through reviewing a product's requests (REST, GraphQL) for the most common security weaknesses, such as users reading other people's records.

wilfred/.agents/skills/crypto-audit/SKIL.name: Encryption check
wilfred/.agents/skills/crypto-audit/SKIL.description: Guides an AI assistant through checking that encryption, password storage, signatures and secure connections are done correctly.

wilfred/.agents/skills/dependency-audit/.name: Outside packages check
wilfred/.agents/skills/dependency-audit/.description: Guides an AI assistant through checking the outside code a project depends on for known security problems and outdated versions.

wilfred/.agents/skills/finding-triage/SK.name: Security finding triage
wilfred/.agents/skills/finding-triage/SK.description: Guides an AI assistant to decide what to do with one reported security problem: fix it, dismiss it as a false alarm, or accept the risk in writing.

wilfred/.agents/skills/NOTICE-cybersecur.name: Credit for security skills
wilfred/.agents/skills/NOTICE-cybersecur.description: Credits the original authors of the six security-audit skills copied into this folder and states the license they are shared under.

wilfred/.agents/skills/owasp-audit/SKILL.name: Top-10 security check
wilfred/.agents/skills/owasp-audit/SKILL.description: Guides an AI assistant through reviewing source code against the ten best-known web security risk categories (OWASP Top 10).

wilfred/.agents/skills/secrets-audit/SKI.name: Leaked passwords check
wilfred/.agents/skills/secrets-audit/SKI.description: Guides an AI assistant to hunt for passwords and keys accidentally left in code or history, and to review how they are stored.

wilfred/.github/workflows/ci.yml.name: Automatic checks on GitHub
wilfred/.github/workflows/ci.yml.description: Runs Wilfred's automatic quality checks on GitHub whenever code is pushed or a change is proposed.

wilfred/AGENTS.md.name: Wilfred AI instructions
wilfred/AGENTS.md.description: Tells AI coding assistants what Wilfred is, how its folders are laid out and which rules to follow when working inside it.

wilfred/CLAUDE.md.name: Claude pointer to instructions
wilfred/CLAUDE.md.description: Makes Claude Code read the Wilfred AI instructions file, so Claude and Codex follow the same rules.

wilfred/CONTRIBUTING.md.name: How to contribute
wilfred/CONTRIBUTING.md.description: Explains how others can propose changes to Wilfred and that it is refreshed periodically from a private original.

wilfred/docs/acceptance.md.name: Acceptance record
wilfred/docs/acceptance.md.description: Lists the must-have requirements Wilfred has to meet and whether each has been observed working, in the public copy.

wilfred/docs/agent-foundry/architecture..name: Agent Foundry design
wilfred/docs/agent-foundry/architecture..description: Explains the boundaries and main design decisions of Agent Foundry, the part of Wilfred that designs and packages agent systems locally.

wilfred/docs/agent-foundry/cli.md.name: Agent Foundry commands
wilfred/docs/agent-foundry/cli.md.description: Shows the commands for running Agent Foundry and a step-by-step demo that can be reproduced.

wilfred/docs/agent-foundry/evidence.md.name: Agent Foundry evidence
wilfred/docs/agent-foundry/evidence.md.description: Explains what proof Agent Foundry must show before something counts as done, and where the acceptance results are recorded.

wilfred/docs/agent-foundry/extensions-fr.name: Planned extensions outline
wilfred/docs/agent-foundry/extensions-fr.description: Frames a proposed extension: agents that use open-source models running on the user's own computer, plus search over documents and limited coordination.

wilfred/docs/agent-foundry/README.md.name: Agent Foundry overview
wilfred/docs/agent-foundry/README.md.description: Introduces Agent Foundry, which turns a supported objective into a ready-to-run local agent system with recorded evidence.

wilfred/docs/architecture.md.name: Wilfred design overview
wilfred/docs/architecture.md.description: Describes how Wilfred's software-building and agent-building features fit together in one installed package and who is allowed to approve what.

wilfred/docs/command-center.md.name: Status page guide
wilfred/docs/command-center.md.description: Describes a read-only local page showing which projects exist, which Wilfred runs are active, finished or stuck, and what needs attention.

wilfred/docs/demo.md.name: Demo walkthrough
wilfred/docs/demo.md.description: Gives the narration and command to run a demo of Wilfred that needs no accounts, with an option to use real AI calls.

wilfred/docs/domain-model.md.name: Planned data design
wilfred/docs/domain-model.md.description: Sets out a design, not yet built, for how Wilfred should record projects, runs and events in the future.

wilfred/docs/human-approvals-policy.md.name: Human sign-off policy
wilfred/docs/human-approvals-policy.md.description: Explains where Wilfred needs a person's signed approval and the owner-controlled switch that turns signing off for three lower-risk points.

wilfred/docs/hyperwilfred-architecture.m.name: Early design (HyperWilfred)
wilfred/docs/hyperwilfred-architecture.m.description: Keeps the original design of Wilfred's predecessor, HyperWilfred, as history; its claims are not current proof.

wilfred/docs/hyperwilfred-continuous-imp.name: Early improvement loops
wilfred/docs/hyperwilfred-continuous-imp.description: Keeps the old HyperWilfred plan for self-improvement loops and routines as history, not as current status.

wilfred/docs/known-limitations.md.name: Known gaps
wilfred/docs/known-limitations.md.description: Lists what Wilfred still cannot do or has not proven, treating unmet must-haves as unfinished work rather than future plans.

wilfred/docs/limits-and-roadmap.md.name: Limits and next steps
wilfred/docs/limits-and-roadmap.md.description: States today's limits, such as three supported kinds of task and Mac-only execution, and what is planned next.

wilfred/docs/threat-model.md.name: Security risk map
wilfred/docs/threat-model.md.description: Maps who and what Wilfred trusts, where attacks could come in, and which sensitive actions need protection.

wilfred/docs/verification.md.name: Verification results
wilfred/docs/verification.md.description: Records the test results and leak scans observed when this public copy of Wilfred was prepared on 2026-11-09.

wilfred/PROVENANCE.md.name: Where Wilfred came from
wilfred/PROVENANCE.md.description: Explains how this public copy was extracted from the private repository, without its full history or unrelated project data.

wilfred/pyproject.toml.name: Wilfred package settings
wilfred/pyproject.toml.description: Defines Wilfred as an installable Python package: its name, version, required Python version and the outside tools it needs.

wilfred/README.md.name: Wilfred overview
wilfred/README.md.description: Introduces Wilfred, a local system that builds, improves and reviews software and designs agent systems, with hard quality checks.

wilfred/skills/hyperwilfred-build/SKILL..name: Build with Wilfred
wilfred/skills/hyperwilfred-build/SKILL..description: Teaches an AI assistant how to use Wilfred to build or improve a software product from an objective.

wilfred/skills/hyperwilfred-review/SKILL.name: Review with Wilfred
wilfred/skills/hyperwilfred-review/SKILL.description: Teaches an AI assistant how to use Wilfred to review the quality and security of an existing project or change.
